name: Apprenticeship — Draft POST With Withdrawal Date
description: POSTs a draft apprenticeship learner (ULN 44444444, standard 21, StartDate 2026-04-01) to the LearnerData Outer API with a WithdrawalDate already set on the OnProgramme item (2026-07-01, three months after StartDate) — no approval event, no earlier POST. Exercises CreateDraftApprenticeshipLearningCommandHandler.CreateDraftLearning's fall-through call to learning.Update(updateModel) straight after AddEpisode: the withdrawal isn't part of episode creation itself, it's picked up by UpdateWithdrawalDate -> EpisodeDomainModel.Withdraw on the same call that creates the row. The draft is left unapproved (IsApproved false) with the episode withdrawn but not removed (IsRemoved stays false — Withdraw only stamps WithdrawalDate, distinct from RemoveLearner/Remove).

steps.name: SLD Creates the Draft Apprenticeship, Already Withdrawn

assertions.name: Episode is withdrawn, unapproved, not removed
